reference_sql:
SELECT isoyear(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS iso_year,
       week(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS iso_week,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-01-04'
GROUP BY 1, 2
alternatives: SELECT EXTRACT(isoyear FROM timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS iso_year, EXTRACT(week FROM timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS iso_week, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-15 00:00:00' AND timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-05 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT isoyear(date_trunc('week', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))) AS iso_year, week(date_trunc('week', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))) AS iso_week, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-01-04' GROUP BY date_trunc('week', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))

other_way.sql: SELECT isoyear(date_trunc('week', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))) AS iso_year, week(date_trunc('week', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))) AS iso_week, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-01-04' GROUP BY date_trunc('week', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))
other_way.tradeoff: Grouping by the Amsterdam Monday from date_trunc('week', ...) gives the same weeks, and you read the labels off that Monday.

solver.query:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT (order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS local_ts
  FROM orders
  WHERE channel = 'web'
)
SELECT isoyear(local_ts) AS iso_year, weekofyear(local_ts) AS iso_week, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM o
WHERE CAST(local_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-01-04'
GROUP BY 1, 2
